intro: Classic Pita Chips are a popular choice from the [CAVA Sides Menu](/menu/sides), offering perfectly baked wheat pita chips seasoned with sea salt. At 280 calories, these crispy chips provide a satisfying crunch that complements any bowl or pita creation. Made from quality wheat and baked rather than fried, they deliver authentic Mediterranean flavor while maintaining nutritional balance.
priceCalories: Priced between $2.55 and $2.95 depending on location, Classic Pita Chips contain 280 calories per serving. With 10g of protein, 41g of carbs, and 8g of fat, they offer substantial energy and nutrition. This pricing makes them an affordable addition to complete your meal from the [full CAVA menu](/), providing excellent value for a baked, sea salt seasoned side.
whatMakesSpecial: What sets Classic Pita Chips apart is their traditional baking method and simple sea salt seasoning. Unlike fried alternatives, these chips maintain the authentic taste of Mediterranean pita bread while offering a lighter option. The baking process creates ideal crispness without excess oil, making them a standout choice among [CAVA Sides Menu](/menu/sides) offerings with clean, recognizable ingredients.
nutritionFacts: Each serving of Classic Pita Chips delivers 280 calories with a balanced macronutrient profile. The 10g of protein content is notably higher than typical chips, while 41g of carbs provide sustained energy. With only 8g of fat, these baked chips offer a lighter alternative. Check the [CAVA Nutrition Calculator](/calculator) to see how they fit your dietary goals.
whatsInside: Classic Pita Chips contain just two primary components: baked wheat pita and sea salt. The wheat pita base provides the foundation, delivering that authentic Mediterranean bread flavor and texture. The sea salt seasoning enhances the natural wheat taste without overwhelming it. This minimal ingredient list makes them accessible for those monitoring additives while enjoying items from the [CAVA Dips & Spreads Menu](/dips-spreads).
tasteLike: These chips deliver a satisfying crunch with warm, toasted wheat flavors complemented by subtle sea salt. The baking process creates a light, crispy texture that does not feel greasy or heavy. Each bite offers authentic pita bread taste with enhanced crunchiness, making them ideal for scooping dips or enjoying alongside your selections from the [CAVA Curated Bowls Menu](/menu/curated-bowls).
customize: While Classic Pita Chips come perfectly seasoned with sea salt, you can enhance them by pairing with various dips from the [CAVA Dips & Spreads Menu](/dips-spreads). Consider adding hummus, tzatziki, or crazy feta for flavor variety. They also work wonderfully when crumbled over bowls for added texture, or enjoyed alongside any creation from the CAVA menu for extra crunch.
pairsWell: Classic Pita Chips pair exceptionally well with all CAVA dips, especially hummus, tzatziki, and harissa. They complement protein-rich bowls from the [CAVA Mains Menu](/mains) like grilled chicken or falafel. The neutral sea salt flavor works alongside bold dressings and toppings without competing, making them versatile enough to enhance virtually any Mediterranean meal combination you create.
healthyChoice: As a baked option rather than fried, Classic Pita Chips offer a healthier alternative to traditional chips. The 10g of protein per serving supports muscle maintenance and satiety, while the moderate 8g of fat keeps calories reasonable. Made from wheat with minimal processing and simple sea salt seasoning, they provide wholesome energy without artificial additives or excessive sodium.
howToOrder: Order Classic Pita Chips by selecting them from the sides section when building your bowl or pita at any [CAVA Locations](/locations). They are available for $2.55 to $2.95 depending on your area. Simply add them to your order as a side, or request them when customizing your meal to enjoy that perfect Mediterranean crunch with every bite.
vsAlternatives: Compared to Harissa BBQ Pita Chips and Garlic Ranch Pita Chips at $2.75-$2.95, Classic Pita Chips cost slightly less at $2.55-$2.95 while offering the same 280 calories. The Whole Pita provides more calories at 320 for $2.25-$2.55, while Side Quarter Pita offers just 80 calories included with bowls. Classic Pita Chips strike the perfect balance between portion size, crunch, and affordability.
whoShouldTry: Classic Pita Chips are perfect for anyone seeking authentic Mediterranean flavors with satisfying crunch. Ideal for customers who prefer baked over fried options, or those wanting versatile sides that pair with multiple dips. Health-conscious diners appreciating simple ingredients will love the minimal wheat and sea salt composition. Great for sharing or adding texture to any bowl or pita creation.
worthTrying: Classic Pita Chips absolutely deserve a spot in your CAVA order. Their traditional baking method, authentic wheat flavor, and versatile sea salt seasoning make them a reliable choice that enhances any meal. At 280 calories with 10g of protein, they offer satisfying nutrition and crunch. Whether enjoying with dips or alongside your bowl, they deliver Mediterranean authenticity worth experiencing.

faqs.q: How many calories are in CAVA Classic Pita Chips?
faqs.a: CAVA Classic Pita Chips contain 280 calories per serving, with 10g of protein, 41g of carbohydrates, and 8g of fat. This makes them a moderate-calorie side option that provides substantial energy and nutrition to complement your meal.

faqs.q: What are Classic Pita Chips made of?
faqs.a: Classic Pita Chips are made from baked wheat pita and seasoned with sea salt. The simple two-ingredient composition ensures authentic Mediterranean flavor without artificial additives, preservatives, or excessive seasonings, making them a clean-label choice.

faqs.q: Are CAVA Classic Pita Chips gluten-free?
faqs.a: No, Classic Pita Chips are not gluten-free as they are made from wheat pita bread. Customers seeking gluten-free options should check the CAVA Gluten Free Menu for suitable alternatives that accommodate their dietary restrictions while still enjoying Mediterranean flavors.

faqs.q: How much do Classic Pita Chips cost at CAVA?
faqs.a: Classic Pita Chips are priced between $2.55 and $2.95 depending on your location. This makes them one of the more affordable side options on the CAVA Sides Menu, offering excellent value for a baked, portion-controlled snack or meal accompaniment.

faqs.q: What is the difference between Classic and flavored pita chips?
faqs.a: Classic Pita Chips feature simple sea salt seasoning, while Harissa BBQ and Garlic Ranch varieties include additional flavor profiles. Classic chips cost slightly less at $2.55-$2.95 compared to $2.75-$2.95 for flavored versions, all containing the same 280 calories per serving.
